messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant"
set: ["stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "stop taking and call doctor right away", "stop using and tell doctor if pregnant", "call doctor right away if become pregnant while taking", "tell doctor straight away if pregnant", "stop using and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking", "stop taking and call doctor right away if unusual changes in mood or behavior", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "tell doctor if are pregnant", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking this medicine", "tell doctor if taking simvastatin", "tell doctor if pregnant or planning to become pregnant", "tell your doctor right away if you have a fever", "tell doctor right away if signs of blood vessel inflammation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
